title: Book Plot, part two: surviving 4,000-book libraries
description: BookPlot worked beautifully on my ~70 books and timed out on everyone else's. The fix meant rethinking the whole map — building it once on a 90K-book catalog instead of projecting onto a tiny corpus per request.

title: Mapping my bookshelf: building Book Plot
description: How I turned my Goodreads export into a self-hosted, interactive map of my reading taste — embeddings, UMAP, recommendations, and all the parts that didn't work the first time.

title: Hello World — Why I built this
description: The story behind this site — why I built it, how the content pipeline works, and where it's going next.
